items.stem: After Copilot drafts an email reply, what is the recommended next step before sending?

options.text: Review and edit the draft, verifying any facts it states
options.rationale: Correct: Copilot output should be reviewed and verified before sending.
Unreviewed AI drafts may contain errors or wrong tone.

options.text: Forward it to Copilot again to send automatically
options.rationale: Copilot does not send on its own; the user remains responsible.
Deleting context is unnecessary and risky.

items.explanation: Correct: Copilot output should be reviewed and verified before sending.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are things Copilot in Outlook can help a user do? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Summarise a long email thread into key points
options.rationale: Correct: Copilot can summarise email conversations.

options.text: Provide coaching feedback on tone and clarity of a draft
options.rationale: Correct: Get Coaching offers suggestions on tone, sentiment and clarity.

options.text: Return content from files the user has no permission to open
options.rationale: Copilot honours existing permissions and cannot surface inaccessible data.

options.text: Guarantee that every drafted fact is accurate
options.rationale: Copilot can be wrong; users must verify facts.

items.explanation: Correct: Copilot can summarise email conversations.

items.stem: A user runs Get Coaching on a draft. How should the suggestions be treated?

options.text: As optional recommendations the user can choose to apply or ignore
options.rationale: Correct: coaching suggestions are selectable, not mandatory.

options.text: As mandatory edits that must all be accepted
options.rationale: Users choose which, if any, suggestions to apply.
Coaching does not send the email.

options.text: As changes already saved to the message
options.rationale: Suggestions apply only when the user chooses to.

items.explanation: Correct: coaching suggestions are selectable, not mandatory.
